title: Board Exams 2027: what Class X and XII parents need to know
summary: CBSE board exams start on 16 February 2027. Here are the key dates for our Class X and XII students and what happens before then.

children.text: Dear Parents,
CBSE has announced the Board Examination dates for 2027. Theory papers begin on Tuesday 16 February 2027 at 10:30 am. Class X papers end on 9 March and Class XII papers end on 9 April 2027.
Please read the full date sheet in our CBSE Circular notice and mark your child's subjects on a calendar at home.
Before the board exams
Pre-board examinations: [DATES FROM SCHOOL]
Practical exams and internal assessment: CBSE has scheduled these from January 2027. Our timetable will follow once CBSE issues its circular for regular-session schools.
Admit cards: CBSE releases these closer to the exams. The school will hand them over and inform you.
For any query, please contact the school office on 02676 225955.
[PRINCIPAL'S NAME]
Principal

title: CBSE Board Examinations 2027: date sheet for Class X and Class XII
summary: Board exams begin on 16 February 2027. Class X ends on 9 March and Class XII on 9 April. Every paper starts at 10:30 am.

children.text: CBSE has released the date sheet for the Class X and Class XII Board Examinations, 2027. All papers start at 10:30 am. Read the instructions given on the admit card.
Class X (16 February to 9 March 2027)
Wed 17 Feb: Mathematics Standard (041) and Mathematics Basic (241)
Mon 22 Feb: Science (086)
Wed 24 Feb: Computer Applications (165), Information Technology (402), Artificial Intelligence (417)
Fri 26 Feb: English Communicative (101) and English Language and Literature (184)
Mon 1 Mar: Sanskrit (122) and Sanskrit Communicative (119)
Wed 3 Mar: Hindi Course-A (002) and Hindi Course-B (085)
Thu 4 Mar: Gujarati (010)
Mon 8 Mar: Social Science (087)
Class XII (16 February to 9 April 2027)
Tue 16 Feb: Physics (042)
Thu 18 Feb: Physical Education (048)
Tue 23 Feb: Accountancy (055)
Sat 27 Feb: Chemistry (043)
Wed 3 Mar: Gujarati (110) and other languages
Fri 5 Mar: English Core (301) and English Elective (001)
Tue 9 Mar: Mathematics (041) and Applied Mathematics (241)
Sat 13 Mar: Hindi Core (302) and Hindi Elective (002)
Tue 16 Mar: Economics (030)
Thu 25 Mar: Biology (044)
Wed 31 Mar: Informatics Practices (065), Computer Science (083), Information Technology (802)
Thu 1 Apr: Business Studies (054)

The list above covers the main Science and Commerce subjects and Gujarati. Some papers last 2 hours, most last 3. Check your own subjects in the full official date sheet, which lists every subject code. No communication devices are allowed inside the examination centre.

title: Subject-wise marks bifurcation for Class X and XII, Examination 2026-27
summary: How marks are split between theory, practical, project and internal assessment in every subject, with the duration of each theory paper.

children.text: CBSE has published the scheme of marks for each subject in the 2026-27 board examinations.
In most Class X subjects (languages, Mathematics, Science, Social Science) the split is 80 marks for the 3-hour theory paper and 20 marks for internal assessment.

In Class XII, most academic subjects have 80 theory marks and 20 internal assessment or project marks. Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Informatics Practices, Physical Education, Geography, Psychology and Home Science have 70 theory marks and 30 practical marks.
Students should check their own subjects in the official circular.

title: Practical exams, projects and internal assessment 2026-27 (winter-bound schools)
summary: This schedule (9 November to 19 December 2026) is only for winter-bound schools. For all other schools, practicals are scheduled from 1 January 2027.

children.text: CBSE has fixed 9 November to 19 December 2026 for practical exams, project work and internal assessment in schools located in winter-bound areas.

This schedule does not apply to our school. As per the circular, practical exams for the 2026-27 session are scheduled from 1 January 2027 for all other affiliated schools, and CBSE will issue a separate circular for regular-session schools.
We will share our school's practical exam timetable once that circular is out.

title: Correction of LOC data 2026-27
summary: CBSE gave schools from 2 to 7 November 2026 to correct the List of Candidates (LOC) data submitted for the 2027 board exams.

children.text: The List of Candidates (LOC) is the registration data, such as name, date of birth and subjects, that the school submits to CBSE for every board candidate.
CBSE allowed schools to correct this data from 2 to 7 November 2026. No corrections are made after this window. Corrections are made by the school through the CBSE portal, not by parents directly.
CBSE asks parents to check that the student's name, date of birth and parents' names are correct and written in full, not in short form.

title: Visit of students to the CBSE Experience Centre
summary: CBSE's new Experience Centre in Dwarka, New Delhi is open to students of CBSE schools from 3 to 30 November 2026. Schools book the visits.

children.text: CBSE has set up an Experience Centre at its office in Sector 23, Dwarka, New Delhi. Students can explore the history of education in India, new technologies, science, innovation and careers.
From 3 to 30 November 2026, visits are only for students of CBSE schools. Schools book a time slot online, and teachers accompany the students. Each slot takes up to 60 visitors.
